name: The Westin Salgados Beach Resort , Algarve
positioning: The Westin Salgados Beach Resort, Algarve: a wellness-focused beach resort beside the Salgados Lagoon Nature Reserve, with direct access to Salgados Beach, balcony rooms and family pools
best_for: Families wanting a beach resort with a kids club and family pools
Nature lovers who want boardwalk rides and birdwatching on the doorstep
Golfers wanting Salgados Golf Course moments away

facts.text: Each room has a private balcony and the Westin Heavenly Bed.
Some premium one-, two- and three-bedroom accommodations have a fully equipped kitchen.
Guests can go birdwatching in the Salgados Lagoon Nature Reserve.
The Wellness Hub Algarve spreads across three levels.
The Westin Family Kids Club welcomes children aged 4 to 12.
Surf lessons and kayak or canoe outings are offered.
Salgados Golf Course, moments away, lies between beach dunes, lakes and protected wetlands.
Cusco serves Peruvian cuisine alongside international classics.
Chiringuito Blue is an open-air poolside restaurant and bar.
RunWESTIN routes wind through the nature reserve and along the coast.

highlights.text: The resort has direct access to the golden sands of Salgados Beach.
The resort is nestled beside the Salgados Beach Lagoon Nature Reserve, and a 10 km boardwalk begins steps away, running between the sea and the protected wetlands.
Some rooms overlook the Atlantic Ocean and Salgados Beach.
There are two family pool areas and a main pool with a more serene ambiance.
Long-stay guests can join workshops in ceramic and tile painting and palm weaving.

considerations.text: Not every room faces the sea; others look over the swimming pools or the resort gardens.
The Kids Club is a seasonal service subject to hotel occupancy.
WhataHotel notes the resort location requires transportation to explore local towns.
